very good hotel; clean facilities, good food & drinks and friendly staff. 10m walk to an excellent seaside. one little downside; parking is rough.

At the heart of Bodrum Pennisula… Wonderful smiling staff. Delicious meals, very clean and silent rooms. Both pier and beach was amazing for sunbathing. Very close to town for walking. Everything was excellent. Definetly we will back again.

We arrived to Olira boutique hotel from Canada, mid Sep 2023. We felt welcomed there from the beginning until the last day of our vacation. Everyone was so warm and friendly, asking how can make our stay the best ever. Without any doubts it was the best. We usually go twice a year to warm places to escape the long Canadian winters, but we were never treated so special as we felt at Olira. Many thanks to the manager Orcan and the entire staff for making our stay memorable. See you again!

Excellent location. Everything was perfect. Delicious food, great sea, comfortable beach area, big room, affordable prices, strongly recommended. Staff were great with always smiling faces. There is no dedicated car park but it was not difficult to find place nearby the hotel.

The hotel is placed in the best bay spot. The room and balcony are big and very clean. The access to the sea is very fast and you have a choice between sand beach or a deck full of sun beds. The menu of the restaurant is diverse and the food is delicious. Also the staff is friendly and helpful.

I brought my 3 young adult children to the Olira Hotel in Bodrum for our annual family holiday. We were all extremely happy with our stay and that we had chosen Olira, which had been suggested by a friend. Orcan, the manager, and his wife were amazing and addressed all our needs throughout our stay making reservations, suggesting shopping and arranging day trips. They really went above and beyond making sure that our stay was as perfect as possible. Our rooms were clean and very pleasant with great views. I highly recommend this hotel, there are many choices in Bodrum but for service, quality and value, Olira is absolutely the best. My only critique would be that the food could be improved and that on busy weekends they ran out of beach towels. Luckily there are lots of restaurants nearby and no shortage of Turkish towels at the markets!

This is an excellent quality hotel next to the seafront in Gundogan, Bodrum. From the moment you arrive the management makes you feel very welcome and this hospitality continues throughout your stay. Rooms are good, spacious, clean and modern with all the facilities that you would expect from a high standard hotel. The hotel has a swimming pool and also a private jetty/pier with sun loungers for direct access into the warm waters of the Aegean without having to get sand stuck between your toes. A really enjoyable and relaxing stay, I would definitely return again and recommend this hotel.
Loved the property, service, and the area!

Otel müdür Orcan bey tüm misafirlerle yakından ilgilenen özel bir yönetici. Çocuklu aileler için havuzu, kumsalı, iskelesi ve yemek çeşitleri ile Gündoğan’ın vazgeçilmez mekanı… Bu sene de bizi mutlu eden bu güzel ekibe çok teşekkür ederiz.

Bu güzel deneyim için Olira Butik Hotel ekibine teşekkür ederim, en kısa zamanda tekrar görüşmek üzere!”
